title: callista subulata
intro: Callista subulata, commonly known as the Starfish flower or Coralroot, is a rare and endangered plant species native to North America. This plant is valued for its unique health benefits, which include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, potentially helping to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Callista subulata include its use in traditional medicine to treat a variety of conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Callista subulata include alkaloids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
